When an operator has raised `JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT` above 15s, this specific wait was limited by the internal `_CAPABILITY_FIELD_CONFIRM_BUDGET_S` cap — not that env var — so the remediation advice misdirects the reader.
